user.title: Connect GarageButler
user.description: In the GarageButler app open Settings → Home Assistant, create a connection and paste the code here.

data_description.code: Starts with gbha1: and contains server, key and your personal token.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect GarageButler
reauth_confirm.description: The connection was revoked or is no longer valid. Create a new connection in the app and paste its code.

error.invalid_code: This is not a GarageButler connection code.
error.invalid_auth: The connection was revoked or the code is outdated.
error.cannot_connect: The GarageButler server cannot be reached.
error.unknown: Unexpected answer from the server – is the app up to date?

abort.already_configured: This GarageButler account is already connected.
abort.wrong_account: The code belongs to another GarageButler account.

update_mileage.name: Update mileage
update_mileage.description: Sets the mileage of a vehicle in GarageButler. Lower values than the current mileage are ignored.

unknown_vehicle.message: {device_id} is not a loaded GarageButler vehicle.
